verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, and the probe confirms it exists. Paired with an llms.txt for agent-readable docs, this lets a user drive Billing operations through natural language. However, that only works through a third-party AI agent client: the evidence shows no first-party natural-language interface in the Dashboard or product itself, and no detail on which Billing operations the MCP server exposes. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documentation of Billing-specific MCP coverage, and hands-on or independent corroboration of NL-driven billing workflows.
